SETUP

    1. Install the Pseudoregalia TrenchBroom game config

        The "Pseudoregalia" folder in this archive is the TrenchBroom game
        config; editor settings, entity definitions, etc. Copy it to your
        TrenchBroom user config under "games". For example, on Windows, it
        should look like this:

            C:\Users\<name>\AppData\Roaming\TrenchBroom\games\Pseudoregalia

        You can check that you did it correctly if you now see a game preset
        for "Pseudoregalia" when you start a new map in TrenchBroom.

        Note that TrenchBroom's config folder is platform-dependent:

            Windows	C:\Users\<name>\AppData\Roaming\TrenchBroom
            macOS	~/Library/Application Support/TrenchBroom
            Linux	~/.TrenchBroom

    2. Tell TrenchBroom where your game directory and build tools are

        The next time you open TrenchBroom, go to Preferences. Select the
        'Pseudoregalia' profile in the list on the left. Locate your game's
        directory and put it in the box labeled 'Game Path'. For example, my
        game path is:

            C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Pseudoregalia\

        Under 'Compilation Tools', for 'pseudochef', put in the path to
        'pseudochef.exe'.

        This step sets important variables that are critical for the next step
        to work correctly.

    3. Install quickstart mod

        To be able to run the game with command-line arguments, download and
        install the quickstart mod, available on Nexus:

            https://www.nexusmods.com/pseudoregalia/mods/113

    4. Edit the map, build it and load it into the game

        Go ahead and make some changes to the map. Make sure to save, or the
        next step won't work.

        Now under 'Run', click 'Compile Map...'. You should see a compilation
        profile already prepared for you. If you've done all of the previous
        steps correctly, and you've saved your map somewhere, clicking
        'Compile' now will build the map into a .pak file, install it into your
        game path, and load it up in the game (using command-line arguments
        which only work with quickstart mod).

HELP

    For information on how the various entities work and interact with each
    other, select an entity in the editor view and refer to the help text in
    the Entity tab on the right side of the TrenchBroom UI.

NOTES

    If you encounter any bugs, please report them at:

        https://github.com/turncoda/pseudochef/issues

    The code is open-source; contributions are welcome.


    Have fun making maps!

                                                        ~ turncoda  2026.07.30
